notes: Corrected: the *unto* of *unto me* was given to the object suffix under rule 18. Rule 18 places the pronoun realizing a suffix, while rule 44 places a preposition the ASV supplies to reach a bare direct object on the verb's unit, so *unto* joins יַבְּמִי's rendering and the suffix keeps *me*.
אָבָה is aligned to the modal *will*, which is the whole of what the ASV writes for it; the infinitive keeps the lexical predicate.
